text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening opinion: \"I think driverless cars would be a cool and neat thing to have\"","quality":"explicit position","description":"This captures how directly the essay states its stance at the start instead of leaving the reader to infer it."},{"evidence":"repeated \"they'll be helpful\" and \"I believe they'll come around\"","quality":"consistent argumentation","description":"This captures how the essay maintains a clear pro-driverless-cars position throughout rather than drifting."},{"evidence":"benefits plus drawbacks: insurance costs, fuel use, road work, crash safety","quality":"balanced support","description":"This captures the way the essay supports its claim with multiple relevant reasons while also acknowledging a limitation."},{"evidence":"mentions both present and future examples: Google testing, BMW Traffic Jam Assistant, 2020 plans","quality":"source-based development","description":"This captures how the essay draws on several article details and connects them into a developing case."},{"evidence":"\"if they're is construction or road work I may have to take over\" followed by safety and law discussion","quality":"reasoned explanation","description":"This captures how the essay does more than list facts by explaining why those facts matter to the argument."},{"evidence":"closing lines: \"The future is coming and everyone is going to have to face that\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"This captures the presence of a clear ending that restates the claim and leaves the reader with a final point."}]}
